rationale: The stock gapped down ~7.7% on strong earnings (beat on revenue, EPS, and comps), which is a classic "sell the news" reaction, but price has since recovered from the $97.55 low to $105.78 — already 75.8% through today's range — suggesting much of the post-gap bounce has already occurred.
